name: decision-compaction
description: Hands back the conversation itself in place of a compaction summary, less the tool calls and results a System One decision model judges no longer needed. The model can be TypeSafe Jev, Cloudflare Clef, Codiv OpenJev, Perplexity pplx-decider, OpenAI GPT-6 Luna, or Jev through OpenRouter, decisions-api.dev or decisionapi.net.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Which System One provider decides: "typesafe" (Jev, the default), "cloudflare" (Clef on Workers AI), "openrouter" (Jev through the OpenRouter gateway), "codiv" (OpenJev), "perplexity" (pplx-decider), "decisions-api-dev" (Jev through decisions-api.dev), "decisionapi-net" (Jev through decisionapi.net) or "openai" (GPT-6 Luna). The conversation text and tool inputs are sent to it. Any other value sends nothing anywhere: every compaction then uses the built-in summary and says why.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model name for the configured provider. Leave unset for its default: jev-latest (typesafe), clef (cloudflare; clef-flash is the other), ~typesafe/jev-latest (openrouter, which also takes a bare jev id such as jev-latest), openjev-latest (codiv), pplx-decider-v1.1-27b (perplexity), jev-latest (decisions-api-dev and decisionapi-net), gpt-6-luna (openai).

providerDecision.title: Decide the provider per compaction
providerDecision.description: When on, the providers that have credentials and can hold the conversation are compared, and if more than one remains a single routing question picks which decides this compaction. A provider is a candidate as soon as its credentials resolve, so a key you exported for another tool (OPENAI_API_KEY, for example) makes that vendor eligible to receive the conversation; decisionProviders narrows the set. The routing question goes to Cloudflare only when cloudflare is among the providers considered and its credentials are set, otherwise to the configured provider; it carries a profile of the job that includes up to 2,000 characters of your prompts, so a second provider can receive data. Off: always the configured provider.

decisionProviders.title: Providers the decision may consider
decisionProviders.description: With providerDecision on, the providers that may be compared and so may receive the conversation. Default: all eight (typesafe, cloudflare, openrouter, codiv, perplexity, decisions-api-dev, decisionapi-net, openai). The configured provider is always considered. Takes a list, or one text of names separated by commas. Unset means all eight; a cleared field or an empty list names none, so only the configured provider is considered. A name that is no provider is dropped and named in one transcript line; the compaction goes on. No effect while providerDecision is off.

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe key
typesafeApiKey.description: Stored as a secret. When empty, the TYPESAFE_API_KEY variable is read, from the environment first and the settings env block second.

openrouterApiKey.title: OpenRouter key
openrouterApiKey.description: Stored as a secret. When empty, the OPENROUTER_API_KEY variable is read, from the environment first and the settings env block second.

cloudflareApiToken.title: Cloudflare API token
cloudflareApiToken.description: A token allowed to run Workers AI, stored as a secret. When empty, the CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN variable is read, from the environment first and the settings env block second.

cloudflareAccountId.title: Cloudflare account ID
cloudflareAccountId.description: The account Workers AI runs under. When empty, the CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID variable is read, from the environment first and the settings env block second.

codivApiKey.title: Codiv key
codivApiKey.description: Stored as a secret. When empty, the CODIV_API_KEY variable is read, from the environment first and the settings env block second.

perplexityApiKey.title: Perplexity key
perplexityApiKey.description: Stored as a secret. When empty, the PERPLEXITY_API_KEY variable is read, from the environment first and the settings env block second.

decisionsApiKey.title: decisions-api.dev key
decisionsApiKey.description: Stored as a secret. When empty, the DECISIONS_API_KEY variable is read, from the environment first and the settings env block second.

decisionapiApiKey.title: decisionapi.net key
decisionapiApiKey.description: Stored as a secret. When empty, the DECISIONAPI_API_KEY variable is read, from the environment first and the settings env block second.

openaiApiKey.title: OpenAI key
openaiApiKey.description: Stored as a secret. When empty, the OPENAI_API_KEY variable is read, from the environment first and the settings env block second.

keepThreshold.title: Probability to keep
keepThreshold.description: The probability from which a tool call, or its full result, is kept. Lower keeps more.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Newest messages left as they are
preserveRecentMessages.description: How many of the newest messages are never changed. The first message never is.

compactAtPercent.title: Compact at context percent
compactAtPercent.description: Context usage, in percent, at which a compaction is requested when a turn ends. 0 turns this off.

minReductionRatio.title: Smallest reduction accepted
minReductionRatio.description: The smallest share of the conversation's characters the decisions must remove; below it the built-in summary is used instead.

maxStateTokens.title: State budget (tokens)
maxStateTokens.description: Most estimated tokens the description of the conversation may take; it goes out with every request. Held to 85% of the provider's documented limit, and to what the request budget leaves beside the questions of 16 tool calls. For a provider whose limit is stated in bytes the description is also shrunk until it fits that cap beside one request's questions; see Limits in the README. A fraction is rounded down.

maxRequestTokens.title: Request budget (tokens)
maxRequestTokens.description: Most estimated tokens one request may take, the description of the conversation and its questions together. Held to 85% of the provider's documented limit and, for a provider whose limit is stated in bytes, to its byte cap as well; see Limits in the README. A fraction is rounded down.

truncateHeadChars.title: Characters kept of a shortened output
truncateHeadChars.description: When a call stays but its full output does not, this many of the output's first characters are kept, followed by a note on what was removed. At 0 only the note is left.
